blocks.caption: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 20, 2026

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — On Day 45 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, her defense team is set to present three government officials as witnesses who will testify on the registration, product approvals and dealings of Cale88 Foods Corp., a banana chips manufacturer linked to her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio.

items: Cale88 figured in the prosecution’s presentation of evidence after Anti-Money Laundering Council Executive Director Ronel Buenaventura testified that the company received around P319 million in remittances from China. Prosecutors and senator-judges have raised questions about the transactions and the company’s initial capital as the defense seeks to address issues surrounding its business operations.

Department of Trade and Industry Undersecretary Ceferino Rodolfo is expected to testify on Cale88’s registration with the agency while Food and Drug Administration Center for Food Regulation and Research Director Pilar Marilyn M. Pagayunan is expected to discuss the company’s product registration for its sweetened banana chips.

Lawyer Eva Marie Mariquina of the Center for International Trade Expositions and Missions will testify on communications between Citem and Cale88, including email correspondence and invitations to food expositions. She replaces Citem Department Manager III Rowena G. Mendoza, who could not attend due to an official trip abroad.
The impeachment court is expected to release the schedule for the next hearings as the Senate prepares to tackle the 2027 budget next week. /dp
